indicator.title: Ausgehende Rücküberweisungen
indicator.description: Rücküberweisungen, die aus der berichtenden Volkswirtschaft ins Ausland fließen, in Millionen laufenden US-Dollar.

workbookNotes: * U.A.E. figures are based on central bank data and other publicly available information.
Note: All numbers are in current (nominal) US dollar. 2024 data for United Arab Emirates is an estimate.
For a discussion of the definition of remittances, see "Workers' Remittances: An Important and Stable Source of External Development Finance", Global Development Finance 2003, World Bank.
For additional information, please also see "International Transactions in Remittances: Guide for Compilers and Users", International Monetary Fund, 2009.
